title: Trump & Xi to Meet Amidst Friction on Wars, Tech, Trade
summary: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping prepare to meet in Washington with technological supremacy and unresolved economic friction at the top of the agenda. Ahead of an approaching trade truce deadline, discussions are likely to center on artificial intelligence competition, semiconductor export policy, and potential Chinese EV manufacturing in the US. Against the backdrop of ongoing tariff debates and geopolitical tensions over Taiwan and Iran, Bloomberg’s Stephen Engle previews what is at stake for both economies. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Asian Stocks Edge Higher, Crude Oil Extends Losses: Markets Wrap
